description: This file is a Node.js script for checking dependencies and verifying project structure within a TypeScript-based project, specifically for the Playwright project. It analyzes source files, manages dependencies, and enforces dependency rules.

methods.name: checkDeps
methods.description: Main function to check dependencies across multiple project packages.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively visits AST nodes to analyze import declarations.

methods.name: calculateDeps
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for a given file based on DEPS.list files.

methods.name: allowImport
methods.description: Determines if an import is allowed based on dependency rules.

methods.name: allowExternalImport
methods.description: Checks if an external import is permitted based on peer dependencies and package.json.

methods.name: listAllFiles
methods.description: Recursively lists all files in a directory.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.
